scope: The six official Google documentation pages in sources.json, not all Google documentation. Original source text, examples, stable section anchors, and hashes are retained. ai.google.dev redirects to the official aistudio.google.com documentation.

ambiguities.issue: Legacy temperature recipes versus sampling deprecations in newer models
ambiguities.resolution: Keep model settings as workflow/API reference; never impose a universal temperature.

ambiguities.issue: Visible step-by-step example versus internal thinking guidance
ambiguities.resolution: Treat the example as illustrative and do not require exposed internal reasoning.

ambiguities.issue: System-instruction priority versus long-context query placement
ambiguities.resolution: Keep essential behavioral rules first and place the task-specific question after long context.

ambiguities.issue: Fixed year/cutoff in example system blocks
ambiguities.resolution: Never insert an assumed current date, model identity, or knowledge cutoff from an example.
